description: 【三重県東員町】指定緊急避難場所・指定避難所一覧 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 東員町. 東員町内の指定緊急避難場所および指定避難所を一覧にまとめました。. Coverage: 東員町. The portal files it under the publisher 東員町. Its tags are 指定緊急避難所一覧, 指定避難所, 災害_避難所_防災. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-05-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
